title: Runtime-supplied text reaches --plain unsanitised, a non-token --scope reaches a remedy, and the plugin listing has no size cap
description: From lore-cli via opum-agent OPAG-448 AC3 (2)(c). lore-cli fix: opum-ai/lore-cli#291, dev dc09ca98: core/agent-plugins.ts printable() collapses whitespace and strips ANSI and control bytes from reason, version and scope; scopeFlag() interpolates --scope only for /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$/; adapters/agent-plugins.ts readCapped() stops reading past MAX_PLUGIN_OUTPUT_BYTES (1 MiB) and reports not-detectable. MEASURED HERE 2026-09-26 at origin/dev f21783a with fake runtimes, quest agents --check --plain/--json: (1) a failing claude plugin list whose stderr held a newline, ESC[31m and BEL put all three raw on --plain stdout inside the reason, forging a line; (2) a codex version "0.1\\n\\u001b[2Jforged" printed raw on --plain; (3) a claude row with scope "user; touch /tmp/pwned" produced the remedy "claude plugin enable opum-quest@opum --scope user; touch /tmp/pwned"; (4) 64 MiB of padding before a valid [] was read whole (max RSS 260 MB) and reported not-installed. No sanitiser exists in quest src/ (grep for stripAnsi, sanitis, control bytes: none). The update path (updateDetail from runtime stderr/stdout, and the --scope argv) needs the same treatment.

acceptanceCriteria.text: reason, version, scope and updateDetail carry no ANSI escape, control byte or line break in any output mode
--scope is put into a printed remedy or an update argv only when it is a plain token; otherwise it is omitted
A plugin list or update output past 1 MiB is not read further and yields not-detectable (list) or updateOk false (update)
Tests pin each of the four measured inputs; the fix is cited against lore-cli dc09ca98; bun run check exits 0

plan: 1. application printable(): collapse whitespace, strip ANSI (CSI, OSC, two-byte ESC) and C0/C1 controls; apply to reason, version, scope and updateDetail in detectQuestPlugin/updateQuestPlugin
2. plainScope()/scopeFlag(): --scope reaches a printed remedy or port.update argv only for /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$/
3. adapter readCapped(): stop reading past 1 MiB; list -> not-detectable, update -> updateOk false. Readers are cancelled on stop, so the grandchild group kill is left to QCLI-378
4. test/qcli380-plugin-output-sanitised.test.ts pinning each measured input, plus mutation controls
implementationNotes: IMPLEMENTED on fix/qcli-380-plugin-output-sanitised off origin/dev e3efadb, ordered first by opum-agent (the remedy injection is a copy-paste hazard). src/application/agents/agent-plugins.ts: printable() (whitespace collapsed first, then CSI/OSC/two-byte ESC sequences, then C0 and C1 control bytes) applied to reason, version, scope and updateDetail; plainScope()/scopeFlag() gate --scope into both remedies and into the update argv. src/adapters/agents/cli-agent-plugins.ts: readCapped() over stream readers with maxPluginOutputBytes = 1 MiB, for both list and update; on the cap or the deadline the child is SIGKILLed and both readers cancelled. The process-group kill is QCLI-378. TESTS test/qcli380-plugin-output-sanitised.test.ts, 9 cases, hermetic fakes. CONTROLS (the check mutated, not the input), each subset predicted before running and each exact: M1 printable identity, 4/9 red (stderr, version, update detail, unit); M2 plainScope accepts anything, 2/9 (remedy, argv); M3 cap at 1 GiB, 2/9 (list, update). Clean 9/9. bun run check exit 0, 676 pass. END TO END, the filing measurements re-run against the fix: c1 0 ESC/BEL bytes on --plain (was ESC, BEL and a forged line); c2 version "0.1 forged"; c3 remedy "claude plugin enable opum-quest@opum" with no --scope; c4 64 MiB listing gives not-detectable "printed more than 1048576 bytes", max RSS 60 MB (was 260 MB, read whole). NOT DONE HERE: the generic --plain renderer prints every string field raw; only plugin fields are sanitised, which is this task scope.
